target.statement: Event-level detection on SWaT under clean DT view: SegDet = 35/35, Recall = 1.00, FPR = 1.38%, Reliability = 0.986

compute.basis: No code released and SWaT requires a signed request to iTrust/SUTD; the pipeline (2-layer LSTM, K=50, multi-horizon rollouts, GMM, CUSUM calibration) must be reimplemented from prose, and the exact 35/35 segment count depends on the authors' attack-segment definition and threshold calibration, so matching the cell is uncertain even after data access.

blockers: No code or configs released (empty link list)
SWaT is access-restricted (request form to iTrust, SUTD), not freely downloadable
Attack-segment definitions and CUSUM calibration details are underspecified, making exact 35/35 hard to match
title: Digital Twin Degradation: Detecting Cyber Physical Attacks via Temporal Inconsistencies
